# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Failure to hold the opening range high and a subsequent revert to VWAP signals short-side exhaustion. This pattern captures intraday mean reversion when initial bullish momentum fails, exploiting the tendency for prices to revert to the volume-weighted average price after failing to sustain opening range breaks. The edge exists because institutional algorithms often defend VWAP, creating short-term pressure when retail-driven breakouts lack follow-through.

## Mechanism

Compute opening range (OR) high/low from the first 30 minutes (09:30-10:00 ET). If price opens above OR high and then, within the first 60 minutes (09:30-10:30 ET), closes below VWAP with a bearish candle (close < open) and volume > 1.2*average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter short at the close of that bearish bar. Exit: stop at OR high (chart-stop), TP1 at 1R, runner trail using premium-stop of 20% of option premium or 10% trailing stop from high-water mark. Regime filter: only active when VIX > 18 and time between 09:30-10:30 ET.
